cases.name: case written declaration direct

steps.source: function make(){class C{}function f<T:type>(v:T):C{return new C();}function f<uint8>(v:uint8):C{return new C();}return f;}const f=make();const selected=f.<uint8>;const result=selected(1);const again=f.<uint8>;if(selected!==again)throw new Error("cache");if(Reflect.typeOf(result)!==Reflect.typeOf(again(1)))throw new Error("identity");"ok";

cases.name: case written expression direct

steps.source: function make(){const C=class {};function f<T:type>(v:T):C{return new C();}function f<uint8>(v:uint8):C{return new C();}return f;}const f=make();const selected=f.<uint8>;const result=selected(1);const again=f.<uint8>;if(selected!==again)throw new Error("cache");if(Reflect.typeOf(result)!==Reflect.typeOf(again(1)))throw new Error("identity");"ok";

cases.name: width capture result

steps.source: function make(){class P<N:uint32>{}function f<T:type>(v:T):any{return v;}function f<uint.<const N>>(v:uint.<N>){return new P.<N>();}return f;}const f=make();const selected=f.<uint.<12>>;const x=selected(1);"ok";

cases.name: plain own result argument

steps.source: function make(){class P<T:type>{}function f<U:type>(v:U){return new P.<U>();}return f;}const f=make();const a=f.<uint8>,b=f.<string>;const x=a(1),y=b("x");if(Reflect.typeOf(x)===Reflect.typeOf(y))throw new Error("argument");"ok";

cases.name: ordinary generic result keeps activation identity

steps.source: function make(){class P<T:type>{}function f<U:type>(v:U){return new P.<U>();}return f;}const a=make(),b=make();const f=a.<uint8>,g=b.<uint8>;if(f===g||Reflect.typeOf(f(1))===Reflect.typeOf(g(1)))throw new Error("activation");"ok";

cases.name: ordinary generic result reuses selection

steps.source: function make(){class P<T:type>{}function f<U:type>(v:U){return new P.<U>();}return f;}const f=make();if(f.<uint8>!==f.<uint8>)throw new Error("cache");if(Reflect.typeOf(f.<uint8>(1))!==Reflect.typeOf(f.<uint8>(2)))throw new Error("result");"ok";

cases.name: ordinary generic result composes captured and own parameters

steps.source: function make<T:type>(){class P<A:type,B:type>{}function f<U:type>(v:U){return new P.<T,U>();}return f;}const a=make.<uint8>(),b=make.<string>();const x=a.<boolean>(true),y=a.<string>("x"),z=b.<boolean>(false);if(Reflect.typeOf(x)===Reflect.typeOf(y)||Reflect.typeOf(x)===Reflect.typeOf(z))throw new Error("parameters");"ok";

cases.name: ordinary generic callable immutable alias

steps.source: function make(){class P<T:type>{}function f<U:type>(v:U){return new P.<U>();}const alias=f;return alias;}const f=make();f.<uint8>(1);"ok";

cases.name: ordinary generic callable conditional return

steps.source: function make(flag:boolean){class P<T:type>{}function f<U:type>(v:U){return new P.<U>();}return flag?f:f;}const f=make(true);f.<uint8>(1);"ok";

cases.name: lexical generic constructor shadows an outer declaration

steps.source: class P<T:type>{outer:boolean=true;}function make(){class P<T:type>{inner:boolean=true;}function f<U:type>(v:U){return new P.<U>();}return f;}const f=make();if(f.<uint8>(1).inner!==true)throw new Error("lexical");"ok";

cases.name: separate factory declarations keep same spelled constructors distinct

steps.source: function left(){class P<T:type>{left:boolean=true;}function f<U:type>(v:U){return new P.<U>();}return f;}function right(){class P<T:type>{right:boolean=true;}function f<U:type>(v:U){return new P.<U>();}return f;}const a=left(),b=right();if(!a.<uint8>(1).left||!b.<uint8>(1).right)throw new Error("lexical");"ok";

cases.name: ordinary generic result rejects a different activation target

steps.source: function make(){class P<T:type>{}function f<U:type>(v:U){return new P.<U>();}return f;}const a=make(),b=make();const h={f:a.<uint8>};function replace(o:any){o.f=b.<uint8>;}replace(h);let rejected=false;try{const f=h.f;}catch(e){if(!(e instanceof TypeError))throw e;rejected=true;}if(!rejected)throw new Error("identity");"ok";

cases.name: width selection uses each captured argument

steps.source: function make(){class P<N:uint32>{}function f<T:type>(v:T):any{return v;}function f<uint.<const N>>(v:uint.<N>){return new P.<N>();}return f;}const f=make();const a=f.<uint.<12>>,b=f.<uint.<16>>;if(a!==f.<uint.<12>>||a===b)throw new Error("cache");if(Reflect.typeOf(a(1))===Reflect.typeOf(b(1)))throw new Error("width");"ok";

cases.name: width selected signature closes captured result

steps.source: function make(){class P<N:uint32>{}function f<T:type>(v:T):any{return v;}function f<uint.<const N>>(v:uint.<N>){return new P.<N>();}return f;}const f=make();const a=f.<uint.<12>>,b=f.<uint.<16>>;const ta=Reflect.typeOf(a),tb=Reflect.typeOf(b);if(ta===tb)throw new Error("signature");if(!String(ta).includes("12")||String(ta).includes("N"))throw new Error("capture");a(1);b(1);"ok";

cases.name: owner group public signature excludes captures

steps.source: function make(){class P<N:uint32>{}function f<T:type>(v:T):any{return v;}function f<uint.<const N>>(v:uint.<N>){return new P.<N>();}return f;}const f=make();const t=String(Reflect.typeOf(f));if(t.includes("N")||t.includes("&")||!t.includes("any"))throw new Error("public owner");"ok";

cases.name: width capture shadows an enclosing same named parameter

steps.source: function make<N:uint32>(){class P<W:uint32>{}function f<T:type>(v:T):any{return v;}function f<uint.<const N>>(v:uint.<N>){return new P.<N>();}return f;}const f=make.<7>();const a=f.<uint.<12>>,b=f.<uint.<16>>;if(Reflect.typeOf(a(1))===Reflect.typeOf(b(1)))throw new Error("shadow");if(String(Reflect.typeOf(a)).includes("7"))throw new Error("outer");"ok";

cases.name: width selected signature ignores caller generic names

steps.source: function make(){class P<N:uint32>{}function f<T:type>(v:T):any{return v;}function f<uint.<const N>>(v:uint.<N>){return new P.<N>();}return f;}const f=make();const a=f.<uint.<12>>;function inspect<N:uint32>(){return Reflect.typeOf(a);}if(inspect.<7>()!==inspect.<9>())throw new Error("caller");a(1);"ok";

cases.name: width owner fallback remains generic

steps.source: function make(){class P<N:uint32>{}function f<T:type>(v:T):any{return v;}function f<uint.<const N>>(v:uint.<N>){return new P.<N>();}return f;}const f=make();if(f.<string>("x")!=="x")throw new Error("fallback");"ok";

steps.source: function make(){class P<N:uint32>{}function f<T:type>(v:T):any{return v;}function f<uint.<const N>>(v:uint.<N>){return new P.<N>();}const alias=f;return alias;}const f=make();f.<uint.<12>>(1);"ok";

steps.source: function make(){class P<N:uint32>{}function f<T:type>(v:T):any{return v;}function f<uint.<const N>>(v:uint.<N>){return new P.<N>();}return f;}const f=make();const a=(f.<uint.<12>>);a(1);"ok";

cases.name: width result keeps separate activation identities

steps.source: function make(){class P<N:uint32>{}function f<T:type>(v:T):any{return v;}function f<uint.<const N>>(v:uint.<N>){return new P.<N>();}return f;}const a=make(),b=make();const f=a.<uint.<12>>,g=b.<uint.<12>>;if(Reflect.typeOf(f(1))===Reflect.typeOf(g(1)))throw new Error("activation");"ok";

cases.name: selection and reflection execute no body or default

steps.source: let calls=0;function effect():uint8{calls+=1;return 1;}function make(){class P<N:uint32>{}function f<T:type>(v:T):any{return v;}function f<uint.<const N>>(v:uint.<N>,x:uint8=effect()){calls+=1;return new P.<N>();}return f;}const f=make();const a=f.<uint.<12>>;Reflect.typeOf(a);if(calls!==0)throw new Error("body");"ok";

cases.name: ordinary overload values retain all contracts

steps.source: function make(){function f(v:string):string{return v;}function f(v:uint8):uint8{return v;}return f;}const f=make();if(f("x")!=="x"||f(1)!==1)throw new Error("overload");"ok";

cases.name: standalone selected callable remains available

steps.source: function make(){function f<uint.<const N>>(v:uint.<N>):string{return "case";}return f.<uint.<12>>;}const f=make();if(f(1)!=="case")throw new Error("standalone");"ok";

cases.name: additive explicit case remains callable

steps.source: function make(){function f<T:type>(v:T):string{return "owner";}function f<uint8>(v:string):string{return "additive";}if(f.<uint8>("x")!=="additive")throw new Error("additive");return f;}const f=make();if(f.<string>("x")!=="owner")throw new Error("owner");"ok";

cases.name: generic library construction remains available

steps.source: function make(){function f<U:type>(){return new Map.<string,U>();}return f;}const f=make();const m=f.<uint8>();m.set("x",1);if(m.get("x")!==1)throw new Error("library");"ok";

cases.name: incompatible owner replacement still fails before body

steps.source: class P<T:type>{}function f<T:type>(v:T):string{return "owner";}function f<uint8>(v:uint8):P.<uint8>{return new P.<uint8>();}

cases.name: failed selected argument leaves unrelated contexts usable

steps.source: function make(){class P<N:uint32>{}function f<T:type>(v:T):any{return v;}function f<uint.<const N>>(v:uint.<N>){return new P.<N>();}return f;}const f=make();const a=f.<uint.<12>>;function bad():any{return 5000;}let rejected=false;try{a(bad());}catch(e){if(!(e instanceof RangeError))throw e;rejected=true;}if(!rejected)throw new Error("argument");const b=f.<uint.<16>>;b(5000);a(1);if(f.<string>("x")!=="x")throw new Error("cleanup");"ok";

cases.name: type captures instantiate the selected inferred result

steps.source: function make(){class P<T:type>{}function f<A:type,B:type>(a:A,b:B):any{return a;}function f<const T,T>(a:T,b:T){return new P.<T>();}return f;}const f=make();const a=f.<uint8,uint8>,b=f.<string,string>;if(Reflect.typeOf(a(1,2))===Reflect.typeOf(b("x","y")))throw new Error("capture");"ok";

cases.name: unapplied generic value ignores caller own parameter name

steps.source: function make(){class P<T:type>{}function f<U:type>(v:U){return new P.<U>();}return f;}const f=make();function inspect<U:type>(){return Reflect.typeOf(f);}if(inspect.<uint8>()!==inspect.<string>())throw new Error("caller");f.<uint8>(1);f.<string>("x");"ok";

steps.source: function make(){class P<N:uint32>{}function f<T:type>(v:T):any{return v;}function f<uint.<const N>>(v:uint.<N>){return new P.<N>();}return (f.<uint.<12>>);}const selected=make();selected(1);"ok";
